Vibe_Description: Hilly, coastal city with cheap beer, incredible seafood, and strong nightlife. Perfect for a 3-day weekend on a mid-tier budget.
Sun-drenched Andalusian charm, tapas culture, and vibrant street life. Extremely hot in summer, ideal for spring/autumn cultural escapes.
Historic squares, hearty food, and legendary nightlife. One of the best value-for-money party or history weekenders in Europe.
Canals, cycling, and world-class museums combined with a famously liberal nightlife. Beautiful but increasingly expensive.
Ruin bars, thermal baths, and grand architecture split by the Danube. Great mix of relaxation and intense nightlife on a budget.
Beach meets city. Gaudi architecture, late-night dining, and massive clubs. Very busy, but offers the ultimate summer city break.
Fairy-tale castles and some of the cheapest, best beer in Europe. Gets crowded with groups but has stunning gothic charm.
Dramatic landscapes, geysers, and thermal lagoons. Unbelievable nature but astronomical prices for food and drink.
Gritty, cool, and arguably the best underground club scene in the world. Rich Cold War history and surprisingly affordable street food.
Stunning walled city on the Adriatic sea. Beautiful scenery, high-end seafood, and a premium price tag for a polished getaway.
